SONNAL DUNG HECCHO MAKKI is performed by crossing the right arm outside the left arm in front of the chest, then moving and setting the right foot.
Slowly connect with SONNAL ARE HECCHO MAKKI after performing SONNAL DUNG HECCHO MAKKI.
Cross the left arm outside the right arm in front of the chest from the SONNAL DUNG HECCHO MAKKI posture, then slowly perform ARE HECCHO MAKKI.
When completing the SONNAL ARE HECCHO MAKKI, slowly clench both fists and direct your eyes forward.
When performing ARE HECCHO MAKKI, slowly rise, extending both knees when both fists are almost clenched.
Breathing and moves should coincide while keeping your eyes directed forward.
CAUTIONS FOR SHIPJIN SECOND PART, TAKING A CLOSER LOOK
When performing WEN SONNA GO DORO ARE MAKKI, be careful not to let the blocking left arm move outside the left leg.
When PAUI MIUGI is completed, the wrist and elbow should not be straight, and both elbows must not open backwards.
The torso must not swerve in one direction.
When performing SONNAL DUNG HECCHO MAKKI, be careful not to let the back of the hand blade move outside the shoulder line.
When performing SONNAL ARE HECCHO MAKKI, be mindful of your breathing and the moves while staring forward.
When performing KULLO ORIGI, the arm must not be pulled behind past the waist. Then it is raised.
ORIUN APCHAGI, CHET DARI JIRUGI, WEN APCHAGI, CHET DARI JIRUGI, ORIUN APCHAGI, and ORIUN DUNG JUMOK GO DORO APCHAGI.
When performing ORIUN APCHAGI, hold both hands and pull to the left from the PAUI MIUGI posture.
Then perform APCHAGI along with CHAGEUN DOLJEOGI.
APCHAGI and DANGYO CHAGEUN DOLJEOGI must be performed simultaneously, and both arms being pulled along with the kicking foot must be harmonious in force and speed.
When performing ORIUN CHET DARI JIRUGI, complete the move by twisting the back the moment the right heel touches the ground from the left back.
When performing ORIUN DUNG JUMOK GO DORO APCHAGI, the foot that performed ORIUN APCHAGI must move forward more than one step and perform JITJIGI.
Next, assume the ORIUN DWIKKOWA SEOGI posture.
You must shout while this is done.
Cautions for SHIPJIN third part, taking a closer look.
When performing APCHAGI, be careful not to pull both fists for CHAGEUN DOLJEOGI and then kick.
Both arms should be raised to the same elevation for CHET DARI JIRUGI, and the space between the fists should not be too wide nor narrow.
When performing DUNG JUMOK GO DORO APCHAGI, the back of the hand of the assisting arm should not face upward.
The key moves of SHIPJIN fourth part consist of BAOIMIRGI.
When performing PYEON SON EOK GORO ARE MAGI, assume the WEN BEOM SEOGI posture while pulling the left foot.
Both hands start at the right waist, then cross the right arm over the left arm.
Cautions for SHIPJIN fourth part, taking a closer look.
